name: TNT Mania
description: 250 new kinds of TNT: bigger blasts up to a crater 120 blocks wide, TNT that digs tunnels and quarries, TNT that turns the ground into gold or paints it, TNT that builds a house, a castle or a hedge maze, TNT full of mobs, potions, lightning and fireworks. Each one has its own look, a recipe, and a line that says what it does. Fill mode (Esc, TNT Mania) places a whole area of TNT with one click. Everyone who plays needs the mod.
